description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain with a location on Rosser Avenue in Burnaby, offering delivery, takeout, and dine-in service. The brand emphasises Canadian-grown ingredients, house-made dough, and a broad selection of plant-based toppings. Touring cyclists looking for a hot meal with vegetarian or vegan options will find a familiar, accessible option here.
